expected.valueText: Intimate the TPA (planned: at least 72 hours before admission; emergency: within 24 hours of admission); the network hospital sends the signed pre-authorisation form with documents to the TPA; the TPA issues an authorisation letter to the hospital stating the amount authorised after verifying eligibility and admissibility; final authorisation is granted on the hospital's discharge request.
expected.quote: The TPA shall issue the authorisation letter to the Network Provider, specifying the amount authorised, after verifying the eligibility of the Insured Person and the admissibility of the claim.

expected.valueText: The pre-authorisation request states the room category sought; if a higher-than-eligible room is chosen, authorisation is sought for the eligible category only and the difference is handled under the room rent clause in Section C.
expected.quote: If the Insured Person opts for a room category higher than the eligible category, the Network Provider shall seek authorisation for the eligible category only and any resulting difference shall be dealt with as per the room rent clause in Section C.

expected.valueText: After cashless authorisation no deposit may be collected for admissible expenses; the hospital may collect non-payable items, co-payment and expenses above the authorised amount.

expected.quote: Once cashless authorisation has been granted, the Network Provider shall not collect any deposit from the Insured Person for admissible expenses. The Network Provider may collect amounts towards non-payable items, co-payment and expenses in excess of the authorised amount.
